pairwise.reason: Submission X is superior across both models. For Rack A, X accurately models servers of varied heights (1U, 2U, blanking panels) visible through the front mesh door with realistic status LEDs and rear details, and its cabinet geometry is clean and solid. In contrast, Y populates Rack A with uniform, repetitive blocks, and its split side panels have visible gaps along the center seam where the background shows through. For Rack B, X provides an authentic 4-post rack with proper cage-nut hole patterns on the uprights, realistic 19-inch rack gear, functional horizontal D-ring cable managers, realistically draped patch cables, rear power cabling, and an overhead ladder rack feeding a dressed vertical bundle. Y mistakenly places the side frame ventilation members across the front rack face, models cables as rigid plumbing-style pipes floating in space, and contains stray diagonal edges.
